date_note: HKCERT's bulletin is dated 23 Nov 2026; Pakistan Times gives no earlier day for the National CERT advisory.
title: Pakistan's National CERT and HKCERT issue WhatsApp advisories on multiple vulnerabilities
summary: Pakistan's National CERT issued an advisory on WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business flaws, per Tribune, which names five CVEs fixed in May and November 2026 updates. HKCERT's bulletin rates the risk Medium and lists CVE-2026-23871, CVE-2026-44908 and CVE-2026-102769. It says CVE-2026-23871 "is being scattered exploited".
plain: Two national cyber agencies warn about several WhatsApp flaws and tell users to install the vendor's updates.
exec: National CERT and HKCERT both advise updating WhatsApp.
action: HKCERT advises applying the vendor's fixes: WhatsApp for Android v2.26.35.74 or later and for iOS v2.26.24.72 or later; National CERT, per Tribune, advises updating from the official app store.

validation.note: HKCERT's own bulletin, The Express Tribune and Pakistan Times each state the advisory and the WhatsApp flaws; the National CERT PDF was not read.
